source_publisher: RegNLP (Tuba Gokhan, Ted Briscoe; Natural Legal Language Processing Workshop 2025 / ACL)
licence: Apache-2.0 (dataset card); underlying corpus derived from Abu Dhabi Global Markets (ADGM) public financial regulations
excluded_components: ObliQA_MultiPassage.json (full unsplit release) - could not be fully retrieved from GitHub due to sustained slow transfer; train/val/test splits cover the complete 2,976-record dataset
ObliQA_Validated_MultiPassage.json / .jsonl (GPT-4 connectivity labels) - not present in the released HuggingFace artifact
required_raw_sources: RegNLP/ObliQADataset StructuredRegulatoryDocuments.zip (40-document ADGM corpus) is required to build the retrieval/generation corpus for this eval
reason: Strict multi-passage regulatory QA benchmark with clean train/val/test splits and Apache-2.0 licensing. Score capped by absence of verified answers, absence of negative/insufficient-evidence cases in the released splits, and lack of embedded jurisdiction version dates; suitable as a candidate evaluation set only.
